import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import lightgbm as lgb
import xgboost as xgb
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Define target columns
target_cols = ["formation_energy_ev_natom", "bandgap_energy_ev"]

# Define feature columns (exclude id and targets)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in target_cols + ["id"]]

# Prepare X and y
X = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y = train_df[target_cols].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Handle categorical features using LabelEncoder
cat_cols = [col for col in X.columns if X[col].dtype == "object"]

encoders = {}
for col in cat_cols:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    combined = pd.concat([X[col], X_test[col]], axis=0).astype(str)
    le.fit(combined)
    X[col] = le.transform(X[col].astype(str))
    X_test[col] = le.transform(X_test[col].astype(str))
    encoders[col] = le

# Convert to numpy
X_np = X.values
X_test_np = X_test.values
y_np = y.values

# Apply log transformation to targets (aligns with RMSLE metric)
y_train_log = np.log1p(y_np)

# Split training data into train and validation sets for genuine hold-out scoring
X_train, X_val, y_train_log_split, y_val_log_split = train_test_split(
    X_np, y_train_log, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Train ensemble models for each target on validation split
models_val = {"lightgbm": {}, "xgboost": {}, "catboost": {}}
val_scores = []

for i, target in enumerate(target_cols):
    y_train_col = y_train_log_split[:, i]
    y_val_col = y_val_log_split[:, i]

    # LightGBM
    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train_col)
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val_col, reference=train_data)

    params = {
        "objective": "regression",
        "metric": "rmse",
        "verbose": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "feature_fraction": 0.9,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
    }

    lgb_model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data,
        num_boost_round=1000,
        valid_sets=[val_data],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
    )
    models_val["lightgbm"][target] = lgb_model

    # XGBoost
    xgb_train = xgb.DMatrix(X_train, label=y_train_col)
    xgb_val = xgb.DMatrix(X_val, label=y_val_col)

    xgb_params = {
        "objective": "reg:squarederror",
        "eval_metric": "rmse",
        "seed": 42,
        "max_depth": 6,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.9,
    }

    xgb_model = xgb.train(
        xgb_params,
        xgb_train,
        num_boost_round=1000,
        evals=[(xgb_val, "val")],
        early_stopping_rounds=50,
        verbose_eval=False,
    )
    models_val["xgboost"][target] = xgb_model

    # CatBoost
    cat_model = CatBoostRegressor(
        iterations=1000,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        depth=6,
        loss_function="RMSE",
        verbose=0,
        random_seed=42,
    )

    cat_model.fit(
        X_train, y_train_col, eval_set=(X_val, y_val_col), use_best_model=True
    )
    models_val["catboost"][target] = cat_model

    # Ensemble predictions on validation set
    lgb_pred = lgb_model.predict(X_val)
    xgb_pred = xgb_model.predict(xgb_val)
    cat_pred = cat_model.predict(X_val)

    # Average ensemble
    val_pred_log = (lgb_pred + xgb_pred + cat_pred) / 3

    # Inverse transform predictions back to original scale
    val_pred = np.expm1(val_pred_log)
    y_val_original = np.expm1(y_val_col)

    # Calculate RMSLE
    rmsle = np.sqrt(np.mean((np.log(val_pred + 1) - np.log(y_val_original + 1)) ** 2))
    val_scores.append(rmsle)
    print(f"RMSLE for {target}: {rmsle:.4f}")

# Calculate mean RMSLE
mean_rmsle = np.mean(val_scores)
print(f"Mean Column-wise RMSLE: {mean_rmsle:.4f}")

# RETRAIN ALL MODELS ON FULL TRAINING DATA for final test predictions
print("Retraining models on full training data...")
models_full = {"lightgbm": {}, "xgboost": {}, "catboost": {}}

for i, target in enumerate(target_cols):
    y_train_col_full = y_train_log[:, i]

    # LightGBM on full data
    train_data_full = lgb.Dataset(X_np, label=y_train_col_full)

    lgb_model_full = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data_full,
        num_boost_round=1000,
        verbose_eval=0,
    )
    models_full["lightgbm"][target] = lgb_model_full

    # XGBoost on full data
    xgb_train_full = xgb.DMatrix(X_np, label=y_train_col_full)

    xgb_model_full = xgb.train(
        xgb_params,
        xgb_train_full,
        num_boost_round=1000,
        verbose_eval=False,
    )
    models_full["xgboost"][target] = xgb_model_full

    # CatBoost on full data
    cat_model_full = CatBoostRegressor(
        iterations=1000,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        depth=6,
        loss_function="RMSE",
        verbose=0,
        random_seed=42,
    )

    cat_model_full.fit(X_np, y_train_col_full)
    models_full["catboost"][target] = cat_model_full

# Predict on test set using retrained ensemble models
test_preds = {}
for target in target_cols:
    lgb_pred = models_full["lightgbm"][target].predict(X_test_np)
    xgb_pred = models_full["xgboost"][target].predict(xgb.DMatrix(X_test_np))
    cat_pred = models_full["catboost"][target].predict(X_test_np)

    # Average ensemble
    preds_log = (lgb_pred + xgb_pred + cat_pred) / 3
    # Inverse transform predictions back to original scale
    preds = np.expm1(preds_log)
    test_preds[target] = preds

# Create submission dataframe
if "id" in test_df.columns:
    ids = test_df["id"]
else:
    ids = sample_sub["id"]

submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": ids,
        "formation_energy_ev_natom": test_preds["formation_energy_ev_natom"],
        "bandgap_energy_ev": test_preds["bandgap_energy_ev"],
    }
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
